title: Pause, recover and resume campaign admission
description: A host pauses a real waiting development campaign while an independent commander is reviewing a faction. The pause fences admission and survives reload; acknowledged resume permits the waiting commander to join. Keyboard traversal wraps within the roster and Escape restores its opening control. Starting state uses real UI with explicit development access and fixed catalogue input.

steps.description: Prepare a host's admitted Heliac seat and an independently authenticated Pelagic applicant through ordinary UI. Emulator development claims and fixed catalogue entropy are explicit controls; no production state, pause interval or tick is injected.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Open the roster while the other commander can still claim a seat.
verifications: The waiting commander can still commit admission before a pause.

steps.description: Traverse the closed roster controls in both wrap directions, then open development controls with the keyboard.
steps.acknowledgement: Pause campaign is focused after opening the disclosure.
verifications: The same authoritative campaign remains ready for admission.

steps.description: Commit the pause and observe the waiting player's admission control become disabled.
steps.acknowledgement: The server acknowledges the pause and explicitly stops admissions and scheduled start.
verifications: Resume is available, leaving is disabled, the background command rail is inert and the applicant cannot claim a seat.

steps.description: Reload and recover the persisted maintenance pause.
steps.acknowledgement: The recovered galaxy discloses the development maintenance pause.
verifications: The independent applicant remains unable to join after the host reloads.

steps.description: Reopen the roster and reach Resume with the keyboard, skipping disabled Leave.
steps.acknowledgement: Resume campaign is focused and ready.
verifications: Leaving remains disabled until the server accepts resume.

steps.description: Resume the campaign and wait for the applicant's admission control to reopen.
steps.acknowledgement: The authoritative receipt confirms Campaign resumed.
verifications: Leaving and claiming a seat become available after acceptance.

steps.description: Close the roster with Escape and return focus to its opening control.
steps.acknowledgement: Roster is focused on the galaxy surface.
verifications: The modal is closed and normal galaxy controls are no longer inert.

steps.description: Claim the reopened seat and inspect its acknowledged roster entry.
steps.acknowledgement: The applicant receives seat confirmation and the host sees Waiting envoy.
verifications: Both commanders see the real persisted campaign; it remains waiting for a full roster.
